title: ARIA
definition: Accessible Rich Internet Applications (ARIA) is a set of attributes that define ways to make web content and web applications more accessible. ARIA is strictly meant to bridge gaps where native semantic HTML falls short.
simpleExplanation: A set of special tags you add to complex custom UI components (like a custom dropdown) to explicitly tell screen readers exactly what the component is and what state it is in.
terminalOutput:
First Rule of ARIA:
No ARIA is better than bad ARIA.
Always prefer native semantic HTML elements over ARIA attributes whenever possible.
